bio: I'm Ash, a UGC creator for gaming, tech and lifestyle brands. I've been gaming since the cartridge days and I can't walk past a new gadget without opening the box, so I talk about your product like someone who already uses it.
I make short vertical videos for paid ads and organic posts: hooks that earn the next three seconds, honest demos and real setups. Clear brief, quick replies, files on time.
